channel.title: Maciej Lewandowski - Custody Engineering Notes
channel.description: Field notes from custody and wallet infrastructure: Bitcoin, EVM, Solana, and the backend systems that hold real money.

item.title: Money in Rust: Making Illegal States Unrepresentable
item.description: Newtypes, phantom-typed currencies, checked arithmetic and typestate - how much of a financial bug class the compiler can take off your hands, for zero bytes.

item.title: Your Backtest Is Lying to You
item.description: Look-ahead bias, survivorship, point-in-time data and overfitting - why a backtest is a replay engine, and what that demands of it.

item.title: Why Your Deposit Detection Misses Money
item.description: The deposit paths that silently lose money on EVM, Bitcoin and Solana, and why continuous reconciliation is the only real fix.

item.title: Transaction State Machines for Multi-Chain Custody: What Actually Breaks
item.description: Broadcast is not done, confirmed is not final, and retries are where money gets lost.

item.title: UTXO Coin Selection in Production
item.description: Your Bitcoin balance is not a number, it is a set. Fees, dust, privacy and the concurrency problem the tutorials skip.

item.title: Stuck Transactions at Scale: RBF, CPFP and the Pinning Problem
item.description: A remediation playbook for transactions that will not confirm, across Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana.
